rows.title: Opening run follows the Design Release 2.1 step order and ends on the review page
rows.detail: A trader starting a new notification is carried through the pages in Design Release 2.1's order: the reason for import is asked straight after what is being imported and before commodity details; the CPH number page is no longer a step after roles and addresses (it is reached only from its row there); roles and addresses goes on to the contact address unless everything is already complete; and the contact address always goes on to the review page, which names anything still outstanding. Sam's 9 October afternoon ruling makes the same run-ends-on-review change in the high-risk plants frontend in this increment, with plants keeping its own step order, and the plants rulings ledger records it as a new decision superseding d-069. The tests repo's full journey is rewritten as Design Release 2.1's cattle-by-air journey in the new order, because today's cattle-by-road walk follows the old order and would break.
acceptanceCriteria: In a new notification's opening run, 'Save and continue' on 'What are you importing?' goes to 'Main reason for import', and 'Save and continue' on 'Main reason for import' goes to 'Commodity details'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1495-1501; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-180)

In the opening run, 'Save and continue' on 'Commodity details' goes to 'Identification details' when a chosen commodity needs animal identifiers, and otherwise on to the next step that applies. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1495-1501; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-180)

In the opening run, 'Save and continue' on 'Roles and addresses' goes to 'Contact address for this consignment', including for a consignment that needs a CPH number; the run never shows the CPH number page. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1523-1527)

The CPH number page opens only from its row on 'Roles and addresses', and saving it returns to 'Roles and addresses'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1523-1527; repo:tests tests/animals/e2e/features/cph-scope.spec.ts p2-040)

When every section on the overview is already complete, 'Save and continue' on 'Roles and addresses' goes to the overview instead of the contact address page. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1545-1547)

'Save and continue' on 'Contact address for this consignment' at the end of the opening run goes to the review page even when the notification is incomplete, and the review page names what is outstanding. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1523-1527; prototype:dr2-1-specs COVERAGE.md:163-164 p7-143)

The tests repo walks a cattle-by-air notification from create to 'Import notification submitted' in this order: origin of the import with a region code and an internal reference, 'What are you importing?' with cattle (Bos taurus), 'Main reason for import' (Internal market, Breeding), 'Commodity details' for 2 animals, 'Identification details' with an ear tag and passport for each animal, 'Additional details' with the unweaned question answered, arrival details by air, transporter, documents, 'Roles and addresses' with a CPH number, contact address, review, declaration. (prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/journeys.fit.spec.js:222-236 p4-068; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-197, p12-198)

In that walk, every task on the overview reads 'Complete' before the review is opened, and the review shows the origin with its region code, the internal reference, Bos taurus, Breeding, the purpose given, the CPH number and the chosen transporter. (prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/journeys.fit.spec.js:222-236 p7-204)

In the high-risk plants frontend, 'Continue' on the consignment contact page, the last step of plants' opening run, goes to plants' check your answers page even when the notification is incomplete, and that page shows the unfinished notification and names what is outstanding. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-025, p3-013; repo:plantsfrontend p2-013, p2-017; c-312)

In the high-risk plants frontend, 'Continue' on check your answers for an incomplete notification shows check your answers again with its errors instead of going to the overview; only the declaration and confirmation still wait for a complete notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-025, p2-054, p2-059; repo:plantsfrontend p2-013)

The high-risk plants opening run keeps its own step order (commodity type, commodities list, origin, arrival status, arrival details, place of destination, consignor, identification numbers, consignment contact) up to the new last hop. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-025; repo:plantsfrontend p2-017)

The plants rulings ledger holds a new decision, dated after 6 September 2026, that supersedes d-069's run landing on the overview hub with the run landing on check your answers; d-069 is marked superseded and its own text is unchanged. (repo:plantsfrontend p9-005, p9-129, p9-155; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-025)

rows.title: A page opened from an overview task returns to the overview when saved
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 sends a trader who opens a page from its task on the overview back to the overview on 'Save and continue', rather than on through the rest of the page's flow section. Today 'What are you importing?' runs on to commodity details, the main reason for import to additional details, arrival details to transit countries and the transporter, and roles and addresses to the CPH number page. The service tells such a page by its own journey state, not by a marker in the page address: any save made outside the opening run and outside a change from the review page returns to the overview (9 October ruling, c-276). Every page the journey chains to today has its own row on the overview, so nothing becomes unreachable.
acceptanceCriteria: Opened from its overview task, 'What are you importing?' goes to the overview on 'Save and continue', not to 'Commodity details'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1588-1602 p1-071; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-196)

Opened from its overview task, 'Main reason for import' goes to the overview on 'Save and continue', not to 'Additional details'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1588-1602; trace:animals-fit p1-059, p1-060)

Opened from its overview task, 'Arrival details' goes to the overview on 'Save and continue', not to 'Transit countries' or the transporter page. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1588-1602; trace:e2e p14-091)

Opened from its overview task, 'Roles and addresses' goes to the overview on 'Save and continue', not to the CPH number page, including for a consignment that needs a CPH number. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1588-1602; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-197; trace:animals-fit p1-061)

'Commodity details', 'Additional details', 'Transit countries' and the transporter page each open from their own overview row and return to the overview on 'Save and continue'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1588-1602; repo:tests p2-019-m1)

'Upload documents' opened from the overview keeps its add-another round trip on the page, then returns to the overview on 'Save and continue'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1588-1602; repo:tests p2-066-m1)

A page opened from its overview task has the same address as when it is reached in the opening run, with nothing added to the link or the form to mark that it came from the overview, and still returns to the overview on 'Save and continue'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-198)

A new notification's opening run, started from the dashboard rather than the overview, still carries the trader from page to page in the step order without stopping at the overview. (repo:frontend p1-167; trace:e2e p14-108)

rows.title: 'Save and return to overview' saves without the page's required-answer checks
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 lets a trader leave most pages for the overview without finishing them, so they can come back later. The backend already stores missing or empty answers. An answer that breaks its own format rule is still refused, because the service cannot store a value that does not fit its field (c-211), and consignment details, the CPH number page and the contact address page keep checking their answers before saving.
acceptanceCriteria: On origin of the import, 'What are you importing?', 'Main reason for import', 'Identification details', 'Additional details', 'Arrival details', 'Transit countries', the transporter page, 'Upload documents' and 'Roles and addresses', pressing 'Save and return to overview' with a required answer missing shows no error, saves what was entered and goes to the overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1560-1566 p1-068)
After such a save the page's overview task does not read 'Complete', and reopening the page shows the answers that were entered. (prototype:dr2-1-specs COVERAGE.md:163-164 p7-143)

An answer that fails its own format rule, such as an impossible arrival date or a malformed region code, is refused on 'Save and return to overview' with that answer's error, and the page is not saved. (repo:frontend p1-074; c-211)

On 'Commodity details' and 'Contact address for this consignment', 'Save and return to overview' with a required answer missing shows the page's errors and saves nothing. (prototype:dr2-1-specs COVERAGE.md:162; c-211)
'Save and continue' on each of those pages keeps today's checks. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:1560-1566; trace:e2e p13-113)

rows.title: Hard stops: means of transport on arrival details and number of packages on commodity details
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 makes the means of transport the only hard stop on 'Arrival details', because it decides whether transit countries apply; the other arrival answers can be left for later. Sam's 9 October afternoon ruling makes this animals only: plants' arrival details keeps its own rules. On commodity details the number of packages becomes a hard stop, alongside the number of animals, on each line that asks for it.
